Assistant: User: Can I work full-time on Pre-completion OPT?

Answer: Yes, you can work full-time (40 hours per week) on Pre-completion OPT as long as you're still a student and school is not in session. However, during school sessions, the maximum work hours allowed are 20 hours per week. If you've already received 1 year of full-time (40 hours per week) Pre-completion OPT, the total time of full-time OPT still available would be reduced by 1 year, meaning you wouldn't be entitled to any post-completion OPT.

User: How much OPT can I get after graduation?

Answer: After graduation, you can apply for Post-completion OPT, which usually lasts for 12 months. However, if you have a STEM degree, you might be eligible for a 24-month extension, bringing your total OPT period to up to 36 months. Always consider the deductions for any previously authorized OPT of the same educational level.

User: Can I start working immediately after receiving my EAD card for OPT?

Answer: Yes, you can start working as soon as you receive your EAD card, which officially authorizes you to work in the U.S. for a specific employer. Ensure you have the EAD card in hand before beginning your employment.

Answer: On Pre-Completion OPT, you can work up to 20 hours per week while school is in session. When school is not in session, you can work full-time (40 hours per week).
